title: Iran Police Chief Says “Baj News” Extortion Network Targeted Families of Economic Figures
text:
Iran Police Chief Says “Baj News” Extortion Network Targeted Families of Economic Figures"

"Brigadier General Radan said the Baj News network—Baj means “extortion” or “blackmail”—operated with overseas connections and targeted industrial managers and some officials’ families, especially people active in economic sectors.
